name: ingest_orders
description: Extracts orders from source database and loads into raw_orders. Runs every 15 minutes via CDC (Change Data Capture).

name: ingest_customers
description: Daily full extract of customer data from CRM into raw_customers.

name: ingest_payments
description: Extracts payment transactions from Stripe API into raw_payments. Runs hourly.

name: ingest_products
description: Daily extract of product catalog from inventory system into raw_products.

name: ingest_order_items
description: Extracts order line items from source database into raw_order_items. Runs with ingest_orders.

name: ingest_shipping
description: Polls logistics partner APIs for new shipping events. Loads into raw_shipping_events. Runs every 30 minutes.

name: stage_orders
description: Cleans and validates raw orders. Removes test orders, deduplicates by order_id, standardizes timestamps to UTC. Produces stg_orders.

name: stage_customers
description: Cleans customer data: validates emails, normalizes country codes, combines first/last name. Produces stg_customers.

name: stage_payments
description: Cleans payment data: converts currencies to USD, deduplicates by idempotency key. Produces stg_payments.

name: stage_products
description: Cleans product catalog: standardizes categories, validates prices. Produces stg_products.

name: stage_order_items
description: Cleans order line items: validates quantities and prices, removes orphaned records. Produces stg_order_items.

name: stage_shipping
description: Cleans shipping events: deduplicates, normalizes carrier names and event types. Produces stg_shipping.

name: build_curated_orders
description: Builds the conformed order fact table by joining stg_orders with stg_payments (for payment status) and stg_shipping (for delivery status). Applies business rules for refund classification. This is the most critical transformation in the pipeline.

name: build_curated_customers
description: Builds the customer dimension by enriching stg_customers with order metrics from curated_orders: total orders, lifetime value, first/last order dates.

name: build_curated_products
description: Builds the product dimension by enriching stg_products with sales metrics from stg_order_items: total units sold, revenue, margin calculations.

name: build_curated_order_items
description: Builds conformed line items by joining stg_order_items with product pricing. Computes line totals including discounts.

name: generate_daily_sales
description: Generates the daily sales summary report from curated_orders. Calculates total revenue, order count, average order value, and refund rate per day. Runs at 6 AM daily after curated tables are built.

name: generate_customer_segments
description: Generates customer segmentation report from curated_customers. Computes segment-level metrics for marketing team.

name: generate_product_performance
description: Generates product performance rankings from curated_products and curated_order_items. Used by merchandising for inventory decisions.

name: generate_shipping_sla
description: Generates shipping SLA compliance report by analyzing delivery times from stg_shipping against curated_orders. Evaluates carrier performance.

name: generate_revenue_by_country
description: Generates geographic revenue breakdown from curated_orders and curated_customers. Powers the regional sales dashboard.
